title: React from First Principles
description: Learn React the way it actually works — declarative UI, state, rendering, effects, and the server — in the right order, with the right articles, and nothing extra on the first pass.

modules.title: Orientation and setup
modules.description: Goal: hold the mental model — declarative UI, UI = f(state) — and have a working React app before learning any API.

lessons.title: How to Learn from this Syllabus: Study Guide, Mental Model & What to Skip
lessons.description: The master syllabus guide: declarative UI mental model (UI = f(state)), read-type-break-build loop, study pacing, TypeScript pairing, and what to deliberately skip.

lessons.title: Quick Start — React docs
lessons.description: The 80% tour: components, JSX, conditions, lists, events, state, and sharing data. Read it end to end, in the docs sandbox, before touching your own project.

modules.title: Describing the UI
modules.description: Goal: build any static screen from data using components, props, conditions, and lists — with correct keys and pure components.

lessons.title: Describing the UI
lessons.description: The chapter hub: read it first for the map, then the pages below in order.

lessons.title: Your First Component
lessons.description: Declaring and using components; nesting; capital-letter rule.

lessons.title: Passing Props to a Component
lessons.description: Props as read-only inputs; passing any value, including JSX and functions; children.

lessons.title: Conditional Rendering
lessons.description: if, ternary, and &&; the 0 trap.

lessons.title: Rendering Lists
lessons.description: filter and map over data; choosing keys from your data, not from the index.

lessons.title: Keeping Components Pure
lessons.description: Why components must be pure, and what breaks when they are not.

lessons.title: Using TypeScript — React docs
lessons.description: The typing companion for this module: props, children, hooks, and events. Also TypeScript syllabus Module 8 — revisit it here, in React context.

modules.title: Thinking in React
modules.description: Goal: design a React app on paper before writing it, using the docs' own five-step method.

lessons.title: Thinking in React
lessons.description: The five steps worked through on a searchable product table. Do the whole tutorial, including its challenges.

modules.title: State and the render cycle
modules.description: Goal: make components interactive and understand exactly what happens when state changes — the module that explains most React bugs.

lessons.title: Adding Interactivity
lessons.description: The whole chapter in order: Responding to Events; State: A Component’s Memory; Render and Commit; State as a Snapshot; Queueing a Series of State Updates; Updating Objects in State; Updating Arrays in State; Reacting to Input with State. Do every challenge.

modules.title: How rendering actually works
modules.description: Goal: explain, from first principles, what React does between your setState call and the pixels changing.

lessons.title: React Fiber Architecture
lessons.description: The engine, end to end: the stack reconciler vs Fiber, the work loop, time-slicing, lanes, and the render/commit split. Read it after the re-reads, not before.

modules.title: Structuring and sharing state
modules.description: Goal: put each piece of state in the right place, and share it without prop drilling, using the three tools in order: lift, reducer, context.

lessons.title: Managing State
lessons.description: The whole chapter in order: Reacting to Input with State (re-read); Choosing the State Structure; Sharing State Between Components; Preserving and Resetting State (re-read); Extracting State Logic into a Reducer; Passing Data Deeply with Context; Scaling Up with Reducer and Context.

modules.title: Refs and effects
modules.description: Goal: step outside React only where you must — refs for values and DOM nodes, effects for synchronization — and delete the effects you do not need.

lessons.title: Escape Hatches
lessons.description: The chapter hub; read it first for the map, then the pages below in order.

lessons.title: Referencing Values with Refs
lessons.description: Refs as memory that does not trigger renders; timeout ids and other non-render values.

lessons.title: Manipulating the DOM with Refs
lessons.description: Focus, scroll, and measure; the rules for touching DOM React manages.

lessons.title: Synchronizing with Effects
lessons.description: Effects as synchronization; setup, cleanup, and dependencies.

lessons.title: You Might Not Need an Effect
lessons.description: The most important page in this module: which effects to delete, and what to write instead.

lessons.title: Removing Effect Dependencies
lessons.description: Make effects re-run less often, honestly.

lessons.title: Reusing Logic with Custom Hooks
lessons.description: Extracting and sharing hook logic between components.

modules.title: Async UI: Suspense and transitions
modules.description: Goal: keep the interface responsive while data loads, by declaring loading states and marking updates as non-urgent.

lessons.title: React API Reference (Suspense, Transitions, useDeferredValue, use, lazy)
lessons.description: The reference index. Read the Suspense, useTransition, useDeferredValue, use, and lazy pages (linked from the index). This is a lookup chapter: read those five pages, not the whole reference.

modules.title: Server React
modules.description: Goal: decide what runs on the server and what runs in the browser, and build a page that fetches on the server with zero client JavaScript for its static parts.

lessons.title: Server Components
lessons.description: The official reference: what Server Components are, what can and cannot cross the boundary, and the use client / use server directives. Also read the Server Functions page linked from it.

modules.title: Performance and production
modules.description: Goal: measure first, optimize only what the measurement shows, and let the compiler do the memoization you used to do by hand.

lessons.title: React Compiler
lessons.description: The official guide: what the compiler does, how to install it, and the rules your code must follow for it to work. Also read the memo, useMemo, and useCallback pages linked from the React API reference.

modules.title: Capstone project
modules.description: Goal: prove the syllabus is absorbed by rebuilding your e-learning frontend in typed React, with a written state design and a written re-render chain.

lessons.title: Capstone Project: Rebuilding the E-Learning Frontend in Typed React
lessons.description: Rebuild the Lumina / EduNest e-learning frontend in React + TypeScript (Vite starter, or Next.js App Router if you did Module 8): course catalog, search and filter, course detail, and an enrol form.

title: Spring Boot 3 & Microservices Architecture
description: A comprehensive, step-by-step staircase roadmap from foundational build tools and networking to Spring Framework core, Spring Boot 3 REST APIs, JPA persistence, cloud-native infrastructure, distributed messaging, and Kubernetes orchestration.

modules.title: Build Tools & Version Control (Maven & Git)
modules.description: Build lifecycle management, POM coordinates, dependency resolution graphs, plugins, and production Git version control workflows from first principles.

lessons.title: Maven Architecture & Build Lifecycle (POM, Plugins, Lifecycle Phases)
lessons.description: Coordinates (groupId, artifactId, version), dependency tree scopes, plugin execution goals, and standard lifecycle phases (compile, test, package, install).

lessons.title: Git Architecture & Production Workflows: Under the Hood, DAG & Branching
lessons.description: Understand Git from first principles: object store internals (Blobs, Trees, Commits), DAG graphs, branch pointers, fast-forward vs 3-way merges, rebasing, and emergency recovery with reflog.

lessons.title: Spring Boot CLI & Command-Line Operations: Maven Wrapper, Launch Arguments & Layertools
lessons.description: Terminal-first project bootstrapping via cURL, running with profiles and JVM flags via ./mvnw spring-boot:run, OCI container building with Buildpacks, and Layertools multi-stage Docker optimization.

modules.title: Basic Networking & Relational Databases
modules.description: HTTP wire protocol, status code semantics, header negotiation, SQL query mechanics, and ACID guarantees.

lessons.title: HTTP Protocol Internals: Methods, Status Codes, Headers & Cookies
lessons.description: HTTP request/response framing, idempotency across GET/PUT/DELETE/PATCH, cache headers, cookies, and 2xx/3xx/4xx/5xx status code taxonomy.

lessons.title: Relational Database Fundamentals: SQL Joins, Indexes, ACID & Normalization
lessons.description: Relational modeling, inner/outer joins, B-Tree index scan vs sequential scan, normalization forms, and ACID transaction guarantees under load.

modules.title: Inversion of Control (IoC) & Dependency Injection (DI)
modules.description: Decoupling component lifecycles, inversion of control architecture, and comparing injection strategies.

lessons.title: Why Dependency Injection? Decoupling, Testability & Separation of Concerns
lessons.description: Why DI? Decoupling class coupling, testability through test doubles, and separation of creation concerns from business execution.

lessons.title: Dependency Injection Variants: Constructor, Setter & Field Injection
lessons.description: Why constructor injection is the gold standard (immutability, fail-fast null safety), setter injection for optional dependencies, and why field injection is an anti-pattern.

modules.title: Spring ApplicationContext & Bean Lifecycle
modules.description: Container instantiation, bean definition registries, scoping semantics, and lifecycle callback execution.

lessons.title: Spring Bean Definitions, Naming & Scopes
lessons.description: Core architecture of Bean Definitions, container naming conventions, and scoping mechanics across singleton, prototype, request, and session scopes.

lessons.title: Bean Lifecycle Callbacks: Initialization, Destruction & Post-Processors
lessons.description: Complete lifecycle traversal: @PostConstruct, @PreDestroy, InitializingBean, DisposableBean, and BeanPostProcessor hook mechanics.

modules.title: Spring Configuration Approaches
modules.description: Stereotype annotations, Java-based configuration, component scanning, and dependency resolution disambiguation.

lessons.title: Annotation-Driven Configuration: @Configuration, @Bean & Component Scanning
lessons.description: @Configuration CGLIB proxy semantics, @Bean factory methods, and stereotype discovery (@Component, @Service, @Repository, @ComponentScan).

lessons.title: Bean Disambiguation: @Autowired, @Qualifier & @Primary Resolution
lessons.description: Resolving NoUniqueBeanDefinitionException using @Qualifier, setting default fallbacks with @Primary, and collection injection patterns.

modules.title: Spring Expression Language (SpEL) & Environment
modules.description: Runtime expression parsing, dynamic property evaluation, and external configuration loading.

lessons.title: Reading Properties with @Value, Profiles & SpEL Evaluation
lessons.description: Injecting properties with @Value, SpEL syntax (#{...}), Environment property sources, and dynamic @Profile activation.

modules.title: Aspect-Oriented Programming (Spring AOP)
modules.description: Decoupling cross-cutting concerns, pointcut expression languages, and runtime proxy interception.

lessons.title: AOP Core Primitives: Cross-Cutting Concerns, Pointcuts & JoinPoints
lessons.description: Decomposing cross-cutting concerns: Aspects, JoinPoints, Pointcut expression syntax (execution, within, @annotation), and JDK Dynamic Proxy vs CGLIB.

lessons.title: Practical Advices: Intercepting Logging, Performance Timing & Transactions
lessons.description: Writing production advices: @Before input validation, @AfterReturning audits, and @Around ProceedingJoinPoint for method execution telemetry.

modules.title: Spring Boot 3 Fundamentals
modules.description: Conventions over configuration, bootstrap sequences, auto-configuration conditions, and container runtimes.

lessons.title: What is Spring Boot? Opinionated Conventions & Initializr Anatomy
lessons.description: The philosophy of opinionated conventions over configuration, starter dependencies, dependency management BOMs, and the anatomy of a generated Spring Initializr project.

lessons.title: Anatomy of @SpringBootApplication: Configuration, Auto-Configuration & Component Scanning
lessons.description: Deep breakdown of the composite meta-annotation: @SpringBootConfiguration and CGLIB proxyBeanMethods, @EnableAutoConfiguration and Spring Boot 3 AutoConfiguration.imports, and @ComponentScan package scanning invariants.

lessons.title: Embedded Servlet Containers: Tomcat, Jetty & Undertow (Web vs App Servers)
lessons.description: Architectural paradigms of Web Servers, Servlet Containers, and Application Servers, embedded container mechanics, and thread models across Tomcat, Jetty, and Undertow with Java 21 Virtual Threads.

lessons.title: External Configuration: YAML Hierarchy, Profiles & @ConfigurationProperties
lessons.description: Property precedence order, application.properties vs YAML hierarchy, environment profiles, and type-safe @ConfigurationProperties validation using Java 21 records.

lessons.title: Executable Packaging & CDS Optimization
lessons.description: Fat JAR layout, BOOT-INF classes, layered container builds, and Class Data Sharing (CDS) to cut startup latency.

modules.title: Building RESTful APIs with Spring MVC
modules.description: DispatcherServlet pipeline, request mapping mechanics, parameter binding, and response envelope structuring.

lessons.title: Spring MVC Architecture: DispatcherServlet, HandlerMappings & HttpMessageConverters
lessons.description: The anatomy of an incoming HTTP request: Front Controller pattern, DispatcherServlet doDispatch loop, HandlerMapping resolution, HandlerAdapter argument binding, and Jackson HttpMessageConverters.

lessons.title: REST Controllers: @RestController, Path Variables, Request Bodies & Headers
lessons.description: Developing production REST endpoints: @RestController semantics, HTTP verb contracts, @PathVariable, @RequestParam, @RequestBody with Jakarta validation, and @RequestHeader.

lessons.title: Response Handling: ResponseEntity, Status Codes & Custom Response Envelopes
lessons.description: Crafting consistent API contracts: ResponseEntity<T>, setting Location headers on 201 Created, 204 No Content, and unified enterprise response envelopes.

modules.title: Input Validation (Jakarta Validation)
modules.description: Declarative request validation, constraint enforcement, and custom validator implementation.

lessons.title: Declarative Request Validation: Constraints, @Valid & @Validated
lessons.description: Applying standard constraints: @NotNull, @NotBlank, @Size, @Min, @Max, @Email, @Pattern, and distinguishing method-level @Validated from parameter @Valid.

lessons.title: Custom Constraint Annotations & Custom Validator Implementation
lessons.description: Authoring custom validation logic: creating ConstraintValidator<A, T> implementations, composing constraints, and dynamic error payload messages.

modules.title: Global Exception Handling & Error Observability
modules.description: JVM exception mechanics, stack trace diagnosis, centralized controller advisories, and RFC 7807 ProblemDetail standards.

lessons.title: Java & Spring Exception Foundations: JVM Stack Frames, Checked Exception Traps & Domain Hierarchy
lessons.description: The first principles of JVM exceptions: stack frame unwinding, the cost of fillInStackTrace, the Throwable hierarchy, why modern frameworks abandon checked exceptions, and architecting domain exception hierarchies.

lessons.title: Diagnosing & Tracing Spring Boot Errors: Stack Trace Anatomy, "Caused By" Chains & MDC Distributed Tracing
lessons.description: How to dissect complex Spring Boot stack traces, isolate root causes from framework proxy noise, and trace errors across distributed systems using SLF4J MDC and traceId correlation.

lessons.title: Centralized Exception Handling: @RestControllerAdvice, @ExceptionHandler & ResponseEntityExceptionHandler
lessons.description: The Spring MVC exception resolution pipeline, HandlerExceptionResolver mechanics, building centralized controller advisories, and extending ResponseEntityExceptionHandler for standard framework failures.

lessons.title: Modern RFC 7807 Standard, ProblemDetail API & Production Security Hardening
lessons.description: Standardizing API error schemas with RFC 7807/RFC 9457 ProblemDetail, resolving filter-chain security exceptions, and preventing CWE-209 stack trace leakage in production.

modules.title: Layered Architecture & DTO Mapping
modules.description: Controller-Service-Repository boundaries, entity encapsulation, and compile-time DTO transformation.

lessons.title: Strict Layered Architecture: Controller, Service & Repository Isolation
lessons.description: Separation of concerns across Web, Service, and Persistence tiers, directional dependency invariants, why controllers must never call repositories, and decoupling circular bean dependencies.

lessons.title: The Entity Leak Anti-Pattern: Encapsulation, Mass Assignment & DTO Design
lessons.description: Why JPA entities must never escape the service layer: preventing the GitHub 2012 mass assignment vulnerability, resolving Jackson infinite recursion, and modeling DTOs with Java 21 Records.

lessons.title: Object Mapping Strategies: Manual Mapping, Reflection Pitfalls & MapStruct Foundations
lessons.description: Comparing manual mapping with runtime reflection mappers (ModelMapper/Dozer), why reflection fails in production, and how MapStruct achieves zero-overhead compile-time code generation.

lessons.title: Advanced MapStruct in Spring Boot: Nested Mappings, Partial Updates & Lifecycle Hooks
lessons.description: Spring dependency injection, complex and nested object mapping, PATCH partial updates with @MappingTarget, and custom @AfterMapping lifecycle hooks.

modules.title: ORM Fundamentals & Hibernate Entity Mapping
modules.description: Object-relational impedance mismatch, JDBC vs JPA vs Hibernate architecture, entity lifecycle, primary keys, schema constraints, and value types.

lessons.title: The Object-Relational Impedance Mismatch
lessons.description: First principles of why Java objects and relational database tables clash (granularity, inheritance, identity vs. equality, associations, and data navigation), why raw JDBC becomes boilerplate-heavy at scale, and what problem an ORM actually solves.

lessons.title: JDBC vs. JPA vs. Hibernate: How the Stack Fits Together
lessons.description: Clarifying the exact architectural boundary between the JDBC API (driver layer), Jakarta Persistence / JPA (specification), Hibernate (implementation provider), and Spring Data JPA (repository abstraction layer).

lessons.title: Anatomy of a JPA Entity & Lifecycle Rules
lessons.description: Writing a clean @Entity and @Table class from scratch: the mandatory no-arg constructor (protected vs. public), why entities must not be final, and safely implementing equals() and hashCode() without breaking Hibernate proxies or Set collections.

lessons.title: Primary Key Strategies & ID Generation in Production
lessons.description: @Id and @GeneratedValue mechanics: deep dive into production strategies: SEQUENCE (Hibernate pooled optimizer for PostgreSQL/Oracle), IDENTITY (MySQL mechanics and why it disables JDBC batch inserts), and UUID (UUIDv4 vs time-ordered UUIDv7 for B-Tree index performance).

lessons.title: Column Mapping, Nullability & Schema Constraints
lessons.description: Mapping Java fields to database columns with @Column (nullable, unique, length, precision, scale, columnDefinition), the critical difference between Java-side validation (@NotNull) and database-level DDL constraints (nullable = false), and @Transient non-persisted fields.

lessons.title: Enums, Dates & Auditing Timestamps
lessons.description: Mapping non-primitive standard types safely: why @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING) is mandatory over ORDINAL, mapping java.time (Instant, LocalDate, OffsetDateTime) without timezone bugs, and automating createdAt / updatedAt with @CreationTimestamp and @UpdateTimestamp.

lessons.title: Value Objects, Embeddables & JSON Columns
lessons.description: Modeling rich domain concepts without extra tables: @Embeddable and @Embedded value objects (Address, Money), @AttributeOverrides for multiple embeddables in one entity, and Hibernate 6 native @JdbcTypeCode(SqlTypes.JSON) for flexible JSONB payloads.

modules.title: Entity Relationships & Performance Tuning
modules.description: Associations, owning sides, cascading, solving N+1 query storms, disabling OSIV, and high-performance DTO projections.

lessons.title: @ManyToOne & @OneToMany: Owning Sides and Bidirectional Sync
lessons.description: Foreign key ownership in relational schemas, why FetchType.LAZY is mandatory on all associations, and implementing synchronized addChild() / removeChild() helper methods.

lessons.title: @OneToOne with @MapsId & Join Entities vs. @ManyToMany
lessons.description: Shared primary key @OneToOne with @MapsId to eliminate eager proxy traps and extra indexes, and replacing naive @ManyToMany with an explicit Join Entity for real-world domain models.

lessons.title: Cascade Types, orphanRemoval & Reference Proxies
lessons.description: CascadeType.PERSIST and MERGE semantics, why CascadeType.REMOVE on child sides is dangerous, orphanRemoval = true for aggregate roots, and getReferenceById() to avoid redundant SELECTs.

lessons.title: Persistence Context, Dirty Checking & Disabling OSIV
lessons.description: Entity state transitions in the persistence context, why calling save() inside @Transactional is redundant, and disabling Spring Boot Open Session in View (OSIV) to prevent connection leaks.

lessons.title: Solving the N+1 Problem: JOIN FETCH, @EntityGraph & Batch Fetching
lessons.description: Diagnosing SQL query storms in logs, resolving single-collection N+1s with JPQL JOIN FETCH and @EntityGraph, and using default_batch_fetch_size for safe multi-collection fetching.

lessons.title: Pagination Pitfalls & DTO Projections (Records & Interfaces)
lessons.description: Why combining JOIN FETCH with Pageable triggers fatal in-memory pagination warnings (HHH90003004), and how Spring Data JPA Record and Interface DTO Projections eliminate entity overhead.

modules.title: Spring Data JPA Repositories
modules.description: Repository abstraction layers, derived queries, JPQL vs native SQL, and server-side pagination.

lessons.title: Repository Hierarchy: CrudRepository to JpaRepository Abstractions
lessons.description: Repository → CrudRepository → PagingAndSortingRepository → JpaRepository contract hierarchy and query method proxy generation.

lessons.title: Derived Queries & Custom JPQL / Native Queries with @Query
lessons.description: Method name query derivation heuristics (findByEmailAndStatus), type-safe JPQL vs database-specific Native SQL, and bulk updates with @Modifying.

lessons.title: Pagination, Sorting & Slice Query Execution
lessons.description: High-volume query pagination: Pageable, Sort orders, comparing Page<T> (executes count(*) query) vs Slice<T> (infinite scrolling with zero count overhead).

modules.title: Transaction Management with @Transactional
modules.description: ACID transactional boundaries, AOP proxies, propagation levels, isolation mechanics, locking strategies, and programmatic synchronization.

lessons.title: ACID Fundamentals & The Spring PlatformTransactionManager Abstraction
lessons.description: First principles of transactions, why raw JDBC transaction management fails at scale, and how Spring abstracts persistence engines via PlatformTransactionManager.

lessons.title: How @Transactional Works: AOP Proxies, ThreadLocal & The Self-Invocation Trap
lessons.description: Deconstructing Spring AOP transaction interception, ThreadLocal connection binding, why private methods fail silently, and solving the self-invocation proxy bypass trap.

lessons.title: Transaction Propagation: REQUIRED, REQUIRES_NEW & Connection Pool Deadlocks
lessons.description: Deep dive into all 7 propagation behaviors, transaction suspension, and avoiding the catastrophic HikariCP connection pool starvation deadlock with REQUIRES_NEW.

lessons.title: Isolation Levels, Concurrency Anomalies & Locking Strategies
lessons.description: Dirty reads, non-repeatable reads, phantom reads, comparing READ_COMMITTED vs REPEATABLE_READ, and choosing between @Version optimistic locking and PESSIMISTIC_WRITE.

lessons.title: Rollback Mechanics, Checked Exceptions & The readOnly = true Optimization
lessons.description: Why checked exceptions do not trigger rollbacks by default, configuring rollbackFor, how readOnly = true bypasses Hibernate dirty-checking, and routing to read replicas.

lessons.title: Programmatic Transactions with TransactionTemplate & After-Commit Events
lessons.description: Why long-running @Transactional methods wrapping HTTP calls are an anti-pattern, using TransactionTemplate for micro-transactions, and @TransactionalEventListener for outbox patterns.

modules.title: Database Migrations with Flyway & Liquibase
modules.description: Deterministic database versioning, zero-downtime schema evolution, and production migration best practices.

lessons.title: Automated Schema Evolution: Versioned Migrations with Flyway in Production
lessons.description: Why ddl-auto: update destroys production data, SQL migration naming conventions (V1__init.sql, R__views.sql), schema baseline tables, and backward-compatible schema changes.

modules.title: Spring Security 6 & Modern Stateless Authentication
modules.description: Security filter chain lifecycle, lambda DSL configuration, stateless JWT authentication, and method security.

lessons.title: SecurityFilterChain Architecture & Non-Deprecated Lambda DSL Configuration
lessons.description: Replacing legacy WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter: configuring SecurityFilterChain bean, authorizeHttpRequests lambda DSL, AuthenticationManager, and BCryptPasswordEncoder.

lessons.title: Stateless Authentication with JWT: Issuance, Signature Verification & Claims
lessons.description: Building a stateless JWT filter: token generation (HMAC/RSA), extracting claims, signature verification, and populating SecurityContextHolder without server sessions.

lessons.title: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) & Method Security with @PreAuthorize
lessons.description: Enabling method security with @EnableMethodSecurity: hasRole vs hasAuthority, SpEL expressions in @PreAuthorize, and securing service methods.

modules.title: Testing Spring Boot Applications
modules.description: Testing pyramid, unit tests with Mockito, web and JPA slice tests, and containerized integration tests.

lessons.title: Unit Testing with JUnit 5 & Mockito: Strict Isolation & Stubs
lessons.description: Fast isolated unit tests: JUnit 5 lifecycle (@Test, @ParameterizedTest), Mockito annotations (@Mock, @InjectMocks), stubbing with when(), and asserting invocations with verify().

lessons.title: Slice Testing: Web Layer (@WebMvcTest) & Persistence Layer (@DataJpaTest)
lessons.description: Targeted slice testing: MockMvc controller assertions with @WebMvcTest, in-memory repository tests with @DataJpaTest, and TestEntityManager.

lessons.title: Integration Testing with Testcontainers: Real PostgreSQL & MySQL Containers
lessons.description: Eliminating H2 in-memory divergence: running disposable Docker database containers during maven test via Testcontainers and @DynamicPropertySource.

modules.title: Observability, Actuator & Health Checks
modules.description: Production metrics telemetry, custom health indicators, structured logging, and OpenAPI documentation.

lessons.title: Spring Boot Actuator Production Endpoints, Metrics & Custom HealthIndicators
lessons.description: Exposing /actuator/health, /actuator/metrics, /actuator/info, securing actuator management ports, and authoring custom HealthIndicator classes for downstream probes.

lessons.title: Structured Logging with SLF4J/Logback & OpenAPI Spec Generation with Springdoc
lessons.description: JSON-formatted logstash encoders for log aggregators, MDC correlation IDs, and automated Swagger UI generation via springdoc-openapi-starter-webmvc-ui.

modules.title: Monolith vs. Microservices Architectural Trade-offs
modules.description: Modular monolith design, distributed computing fallacies, organizational coupling, and service extraction criteria.

lessons.title: Modular Monoliths vs Microservices & The Fallacies of Distributed Computing
lessons.description: When microservices are the wrong choice, modular boundaries with Spring Modulith, and the 8 Fallacies of Distributed Computing (latency is not zero, network is unreliable).

modules.title: Domain-Driven Design (DDD) Fundamentals
modules.description: Strategic domain modeling, ubiquitous language, bounded contexts, and preventing distributed monoliths.

lessons.title: Strategic DDD: Bounded Contexts, Ubiquitous Language & Context Mapping
lessons.description: Decomposing enterprise domains: identifying core, supporting, and generic subdomains, establishing context boundaries, and defining upstream/downstream context maps.

lessons.title: Subdomain Classification & Preventing the Distributed Monolith Anti-Pattern
lessons.description: Identifying anti-patterns: shared domain models, synchronized lockstep deployments, and chatty inter-service synchronous dependency webs.

modules.title: Database per Microservice & Data Boundaries
modules.description: Service data isolation, multi-tenancy models, and eventual consistency across distributed boundaries.

lessons.title: Service Autonomy & Multi-Tenant Database Isolation Strategies
lessons.description: Why microservices must never share a database, comparative analysis of Database-per-tenant, Schema-per-tenant, and Column Discriminator models.

lessons.title: Distributed Data Synchronization & Consistency Challenges
lessons.description: Embracing eventual consistency: eliminating distributed database foreign keys, asynchronous replication streams, and event-driven data hydration.

modules.title: Centralized Configuration (Spring Cloud Config)
modules.description: Centralized repository configuration, Git and Vault backends, and dynamic property refresh with Spring Cloud Bus.

lessons.title: Centralized Configuration Server with Git & HashiCorp Vault Backends
lessons.description: Setting up Spring Cloud Config Server: externalizing application.yml to Git, secret encryption with Vault, and bootstrap configuration injection.

lessons.title: Dynamic Runtime Refresh with @RefreshScope & Spring Cloud Bus
lessons.description: Runtime property reloads without application restarts: @RefreshScope bean re-instantiation, actuator /actuator/refresh, and broadcast webhooks via Kafka/RabbitMQ Bus.

modules.title: Service Registration & Discovery
modules.description: Service registry topologies, dynamic ephemeral IP address resolution, and client-side load balancing.

lessons.title: Eureka Server Registry Topology, Heartbeats & Client-Side Load Balancing
lessons.description: Netflix Eureka server and client integration, heartbeat renewal leases, self-preservation mode, and client-side load balancing with Spring Cloud LoadBalancer.

modules.title: Inter-Service Synchronous Communication
modules.description: Synchronous RPC communication, modern WebClient, Spring 6 HTTP Interfaces, and declarative OpenFeign clients.

lessons.title: RestTemplate vs WebClient vs Spring 6 Declarative HTTP Interfaces
lessons.description: Deprecating RestTemplate: non-blocking reactive WebClient calls, and Spring 6 @HttpExchange declarative client interfaces with auto-generated proxies.

lessons.title: Declarative Inter-Service RPC with Spring Cloud OpenFeign
lessons.description: Declaring typed interfaces with @FeignClient, request interceptors for auth headers, custom error decoders, and integrating client-side load balancers.

modules.title: API Gateway (Spring Cloud Gateway)
modules.description: Reactive Netty edge proxying, route predicates, filter transformation pipelines, and centralized rate limiting.

lessons.title: Reactive Netty Ingress Architecture: Routes, Predicates & Filter Pipelines
lessons.description: Spring Cloud Gateway built on Project Reactor & Netty: route mapping, Path/Method/Header predicates, and pre/post GatewayFilter factories.

lessons.title: Edge Concerns: Token Bucket Rate Limiting, CORS & JWT Header Forwarding
lessons.description: Production edge enforcement: Redis-backed token bucket rate limiting (RequestRateLimiter), cross-origin resource sharing, and token relay to internal microservices.

modules.title: Resiliency & Fault Tolerance (Resilience4j)
modules.description: Circuit breakers, retry mechanisms with exponential backoff, rate limiters, and thread pool bulkheads.

lessons.title: Circuit Breaker State Machine: Closed, Open, Half-Open & Fallback Recovery
lessons.description: Resilience4j circuit breaker mechanics: sliding window metrics (count-based vs time-based), failure rate thresholds, state transitions, and graceful degradation via fallbackMethod.

lessons.title: Retry with Exponential Backoff, Rate Limiter & Thread Pool Bulkheads
lessons.description: Preventing thundering herds: exponential backoff with randomized jitter, bulkhead thread pool isolation to prevent cascading resource starvation.

modules.title: Asynchronous Messaging with Apache Kafka & RabbitMQ
modules.description: Event-driven communication, message broker topologies, Kafka partition mechanics, and consumer groups.

lessons.title: Message Broker Selection: Apache Kafka vs RabbitMQ Architectural Trade-offs
lessons.description: AMQP smart broker/dumb consumer model (RabbitMQ) vs distributed append-only commit log (Kafka): throughput, message ordering, and retention semantics.

lessons.description: Formulate a 1-page decision memo: split or stay monolith for EduNest, quantify the premium, and draw the modular monolith boundary on paper.

modules.title: Thinking in distributed systems
modules.description: Goal: internalise that the network changes the physics — every pattern from Module 3 onwards is an answer to a fact in this module.

lessons.title: The Eight Fallacies of Distributed Computing & Real Outage Case Studies
lessons.description: Reliability, latency, bandwidth, security, topology, administration, transport cost, and homogeneity. The production outage behind each fallacy.

lessons.title: Latency Budgets: Nanosecond In-Process Calls vs Millisecond Network Hops
lessons.description: In-process calls cost nanoseconds; network calls cost milliseconds. Fanning out to five services pays that penalty 5x or waits on the p99 slowest.

lessons.title: Partial Failure & The Timeout Dilemma: The State of Not Knowing
lessons.description: In one process, a call succeeds or fails. Over the network, it can time out, succeed silently, or succeed twice. The root cause of distributed complexity.

lessons.title: Delivery Guarantees: Why Exactly-Once Message Delivery Does Not Exist
lessons.description: At-most-once (drop messages), at-least-once (duplicate messages), and proving mathematically why exactly-once physical delivery is impossible over networks.

lessons.title: Effectively-Once Delivery: Combining At-Least-Once with Idempotent Receivers
lessons.description: How to buy effectively-once semantics using idempotency keys, unique database constraints, and deduplication tables in Spring Boot.

lessons.title: Retry Storms & Multiplicative Amplification: When Resilience Turns Deadly
lessons.description: 3 retries at each of 3 layers is 27 requests. How naive retry logic turns localized blips into cascading total cluster outages.

lessons.title: CAP Theorem Said Correctly: Network Partitions Are Not an Option
lessons.description: Why "Pick Two" is a flawed slogan. When network partitions occur, choosing between consistency and availability is forced by the physics of the network.

lessons.title: The PACELC Model: The Daily Trade-Off Between Latency and Consistency
lessons.description: If there is a Partition (P), trade Availability (A) vs Consistency (C); Else (E), trade Latency (L) vs Consistency (C). The real-world production equation.

lessons.title: Consistency Models in Action: Strong Linearizability vs Eventual Convergence
lessons.description: Strong consistency at the price of waiting vs eventual consistency. Designing systems around what users experience while data converges.

lessons.title: Coupling in Time vs Space: Synchronous RPC vs Asynchronous Event Decoupling
lessons.description: Synchronous calls couple systems in both time (both must be up right now) and space (caller knows endpoint). Events decouple both at the price of complexity.

lessons.title: Module 1 Exit Check & Mini-Build: Two Spring Boot Services with HTTP Failure & Idempotency
lessons.description: Kill downstream service mid-call, observe HTTP timeout, implement exponential backoff retry, and enforce idempotency keys on receiver.

modules.title: Boundaries: where to cut
modules.description: Goal: draw boundaries the business already has, so a service owns one idea that changes for one reason.

lessons.title: Bounded Contexts: One Model and Language per Boundary
lessons.description: Why a "Course" in the catalogue (title, description, price) is NOT the same "Course" in enrolment (seats, schedule) or billing. Avoiding the unified god model.

lessons.title: Ubiquitous Language: When Vocabulary Conflicts Reveal Architectural Seams
lessons.description: The words business teams actually use. Translating terms at context boundaries and using linguistic disagreement to identify microservice boundaries.

lessons.title: Decomposing by Business Capability: Building Services Along What the Business Does
lessons.description: Catalogue, enrolment, payment, certification. Why capability cuts remain stable even when company technical stacks undergo churn.

lessons.title: Decomposing by Subdomain: Core, Supporting, and Generic Domains in DDD
lessons.description: Differentiating competitive differentiators (Core) from supporting features and generic utilities (Auth, Email) in microservice scoping.

lessons.title: Aggregates & Invariants: Clustering Entities That Must Stay Consistent
lessons.description: An Order and its Line Items belong in one service. If a business invariant spans two separate services, your boundary cut is structurally wrong.

lessons.title: Anti-Pattern Smells: Table-per-Service, Layer-per-Service & The Entity User Service
lessons.description: Smelling bad cuts: anemic CRUD table-services, technical "data services", and god "User Services" that every other team must modify.

lessons.title: The Deploy-Alone Test & Change-Together Smell: Detecting Trench Coats
lessons.description: If two services always change, build, and deploy together, they are one service wearing a trench coat. Merging and refactoring boundaries.

lessons.title: Module 2 Exit Check & Mini-Build: Event Storming EduNest & Mapping Contexts
lessons.description: Run an event-storming session for EduNest enrolment flow. Map commands, events, aggregates, and establish a formal context map.

modules.title: Communication between services
modules.description: Goal: choose the right coupling for each interaction, and keep the choice explicit so it can change later.

lessons.title: The Synchronous vs Asynchronous Decision Framework: Caller Urgency
lessons.description: Ask: "Does the caller need the answer right now?" Browsing catalogue needs an instant answer; sending welcome emails does not. Business needs dictate protocol.

lessons.title: REST Contracts & Versioning: Expand-and-Contract & The Tolerant Reader
lessons.description: Contracts as promises to strangers. Evolving APIs without breaking callers: adding fields, migrating consumers, and reading payloads tolerantly.

lessons.title: gRPC & Protocol Buffers: High-Throughput Binary Internal Communication
lessons.description: Contracts as code, binary serialization, multiplexed HTTP/2 streams, and bi-directional streaming. When to adopt gRPC vs plain JSON REST.

lessons.title: Queues vs Event Logs: RabbitMQ Message Queues vs Kafka Replayable Logs
lessons.description: Queues deliver to one consumer and destroy messages; logs append facts for many consumers to replay. Smart endpoints and dumb pipes.

lessons.title: The API Gateway Pattern: Ingress Routing, SSL Termination & Rate Limiting
lessons.description: One front door for external traffic: routing, cross-cutting auth, token validation, rate-limiting, and clustering to prevent single points of failure.

lessons.title: Backend for Frontend (BFF): Decoupling Web and Mobile API Contracts
lessons.description: Why a single gateway serving web browsers and native mobile apps serves neither. Tailoring payloads, latency profiles, and aggregations per client.

lessons.title: Service Discovery: Client-Side Eureka vs Kubernetes Native DNS
lessons.description: Dynamic instance IP allocation: Eureka service registries vs platform-native Kubernetes Service DNS records. Knowing when Eureka is obsolete.

lessons.title: Module 3 Exit Check & Mini-Build: Spring Cloud Gateway with Eureka & Mobile Route Shaping
lessons.description: Configure Spring Cloud Gateway in front of two Spring Boot services with Eureka discovery, rate limit routes, and shape a mobile-tailored response.

modules.title: Data in a distributed world
modules.description: Goal: accept that data consistency is now a design problem, not a database feature — and design it on purpose.

lessons.title: Database per Service: The Non-Negotiable Rule of Independent Deployability
lessons.description: Each service owns its private database. No foreign keys, no cross-service table joins. Why shared databases are distributed monoliths with latency.

lessons.title: The Only Two Distributed Data Problems: Cross-Service Writes & Cross-Service Queries
lessons.description: When databases are split, you only face two fundamental problems: multi-service transactions and multi-service queries. All data patterns solve one of these.

lessons.title: The Saga Pattern: Coordinating Distributed Transactions with Compensations
lessons.description: Replacing Two-Phase Commit (2PC) with a sequence of local transactions. Undoing failed steps with business compensations (refunds instead of rollbacks).

lessons.title: Saga Coordination Styles: Event Choreography vs Centralized Orchestration
lessons.description: Choreography (services react to domain events) vs Orchestration (state machine coordinator). Why orchestration is mandatory past three transaction steps.

lessons.title: The Dual-Write Problem: The Quietest and Deadliest Bug in Distributed Systems
lessons.description: Why you cannot atomically commit to a local database and publish an event to a message broker. Analyzing crashes between commit and publish.

lessons.title: The Transactional Outbox Pattern: Atomic Publishing via DB Commit & CDC
lessons.description: Writing events into an outbox table within the same local transaction. Relaying events via Debezium CDC and Postgres WAL tailing.

lessons.title: CQRS (Command Query Responsibility Segregation): Decoupling Writes from Reads
lessons.description: Separating the write domain model from denormalized read views. Building lightning-fast query projections from domain event streams.

lessons.title: Event Sourcing: Storing Facts as an Immutable Ledger of Historical Events
lessons.description: State as a fold over events. Event replay, point-in-time auditing, snapshots, and the heavy price of immutable event schema versioning.

lessons.title: Designing for Eventual Consistency: Transparent UI and User Psychology
lessons.description: While a saga is in flight, data disagrees. Designing honest user experiences: "Enrolment Processing" vs deceptive spinners that fake completion.

lessons.title: API Composition: Pragmatic Cross-Service Queries Before Reaching for CQRS
lessons.description: Calling two services and joining in memory at the gateway or BFF. Slow and simple: use it until query volume demands CQRS read projections.

lessons.title: Module 4 Exit Check & Mini-Build: Choreographed Enrolment Saga with Outbox in EduNest
lessons.description: Implement enrolment -> payment -> seat reservation saga with Outbox tables. Simulate payment failure and verify compensating rollback executions.

modules.title: Reliability: designing for failure
modules.description: Goal: make failure boring and bounded, so one slow service cannot take the system down with it.

lessons.title: Cascading Failures: How One Slow Dependency Causes Total System Blackouts
lessons.description: Service A waits on B, B waits on C, C is slow. Thread exhaustion cascades upstream until A dies without having a single bug of its own.

lessons.title: Timeouts as Architectural Contracts: Deadlines and Failure Propagation
lessons.description: Timeouts are design decisions, not configuration values. Propagating request deadlines and why timeouts without fallbacks are fast failures.

lessons.title: Circuit Breakers with Resilience4j: Closed, Open, and Half-Open State Machines
lessons.description: The electrical breaker applied to HTTP. Stopping calls to dying downstream services and allowing them grace periods to recover.

lessons.title: The Bulkhead Pattern: Isolating Thread and Connection Pools per Dependency
lessons.description: Ship bulkheads preventing hull breaches from sinking the vessel. Isolate thread pools so payment delays never exhaust catalogue worker pools.

lessons.title: Retries Done Right: Bounded Attempts, Exponential Backoff & Jitter
lessons.description: Why retries without jitter are synchronized thundering herds. Bounding retries and avoiding retrying non-idempotent failed mutations.

lessons.title: Rate Limiting & Load Shedding: Dropping 10% to Protect 100% of the System
lessons.description: Refusing requests fast with HTTP 429 when overloaded. Dropping non-critical background requests to protect revenue-generating user flows.

lessons.title: Graceful Degradation and Fallbacks: Providing Degraded Service Instead of Errors
lessons.description: Showing cached recommendations with "stale prices" notes beats rendering 500 error screens. Planning degraded modes per feature.

lessons.title: Health Checks Done Right: Liveness Probes vs Readiness Probes
lessons.description: Liveness (is process deadlocked? restart pod) vs Readiness (can service handle traffic? route traffic). Avoiding restart death loops.

lessons.title: Module 5 Exit Check & Mini-Build: Resilience4j Circuit Breaker, Bulkhead & Timeout Lab
lessons.description: Instrument two Spring Boot services with Resilience4j circuit breakers and bulkheads. Load-test failure to observe breaker transitions under load.

modules.title: Observability: seeing the system
modules.description: Goal: answer “which service, and why” in minutes, not hours — because a bug spread across five log files is a guessing game without it.

lessons.title: Monitoring vs Observability: Debugging the Known vs Investigating the Unknown
lessons.description: Monitoring watches dashboards for predefined metrics; observability allows answering novel questions across distributed service graphs.

lessons.title: The Three Telemetry Signals: Metrics, Structured Logs & Distributed Traces
lessons.description: Metrics show what is happening; logs show why it happened; traces show where requests traversed. Combining all three for rapid triage.

lessons.title: Correlation IDs & W3C TraceContext: Propagating traceparent Across Hops
lessons.description: Attaching traceparent headers across HTTP and Kafka hops. Unifying logs from 5 independent services into a single coherent incident story.

lessons.title: Distributed Tracing Anatomy: Spans, Child Spans & Waterfall Analysis
lessons.description: Units of work, parent-child spans, error tags, and reading flame charts in Jaeger to pinpoint the slowest span in a call hierarchy.

lessons.title: The Four Golden Signals: Measuring Latency Percentiles (p95/p99), Traffic, Errors & Saturation
lessons.description: Why average latency hides user suffering. Monitoring p95 and p99 percentiles, throughput rates, failure percentages, and queue saturation.

lessons.title: Alerting on Symptoms vs Causes: Eliminating On-Call Alert Fatigue
lessons.description: Alerting on user-facing symptoms ("checkout error rate > 1%") instead of internal causes ("disk queue depth"). Creating actionable alerts.

lessons.title: SLOs, SLIs, and Error Budgets: Governing Engineering Reliability Trade-Offs
lessons.description: Agreeing on what "reliable enough" means (99.9% under 200ms). Spending error budgets on shipping velocity rather than chasing 100% uptime.

lessons.title: Metric Cardinality Explosions: Why User IDs in Prometheus Bankrupt Backends
lessons.description: Every label combination creates a distinct time-series memory buffer. Keeping high-cardinality values in traces, not in metrics.

lessons.title: Module 6 Exit Check & Mini-Build: OpenTelemetry Java Agent, Jaeger & Prometheus Lab
lessons.description: Attach OpenTelemetry Java agent to services, trace end-to-end enrolment in Jaeger, and formulate Prometheus golden-signal dashboards.

modules.title: Deployment, scaling and operations
modules.description: Goal: treat deployment as a property of the design — a service that only its author can deploy is not a microservice.

lessons.title: The Twelve-Factor App Contract: The Baseline Platform Standard
lessons.description: Codebase isolation, explicit dependencies, config in environment, stateless processes, port binding, and dev/prod parity evaluated against Spring Boot.

lessons.title: Containers as Immutable Artifacts: Multi-Stage Docker Builds
lessons.description: Build once, run anywhere. Compiling slim JRE runtimes, non-root user execution, and guaranteeing staging artifacts match production bit-for-bit.

lessons.title: Kubernetes Desired State & The Reconciliation Loop Mental Model
lessons.description: Declaring intent: "ensure three replicas of catalogue service exist". How control loops continuously drive cluster reality to match desired state.

lessons.title: Pods, Deployments, and Services: The Core Trio of Kubernetes Workloads
lessons.description: Pods as ephemeral compute units, Deployments managing replica rolling updates, and Services providing stable cluster DNS virtual IPs.

lessons.title: Horizontal vs Vertical Scaling: Stateless Processes & Autoscaling
lessons.description: Why adding stateless instances beats scaling up CPU cores. Configuring Kubernetes Horizontal Pod Autoscalers (HPA) on load metrics.

lessons.title: Zero-Downtime Deployment Strategies: Rolling Updates, Blue-Green & Canaries
lessons.description: Progressive rolling updates, blue-green environment switches, and canary traffic slicing using weighted ingress gateways.

lessons.title: Configuration & Secrets Management: ConfigMaps, Secrets & Dynamic Injection
lessons.description: Injecting application settings at boot time without rebuilding Docker images. Mounting Kubernetes ConfigMaps and Secrets as environment variables.

lessons.title: Zero-Downtime Database Migrations: The Expand-and-Contract Schema Pattern
lessons.description: Ensuring databases tolerate both old and new microservice versions simultaneously during rolling deployments. Safe column and table migrations.

lessons.title: Module 7 Exit Check & Mini-Build: Docker Compose Orchestration & Kubernetes Rolling Update Lab
lessons.description: Containerize EduNest microservices with Docker Compose, deploy one service to local minikube/kind, and execute zero-downtime rolling update.

modules.title: Security and configuration
modules.description: Goal: assume the network is hostile, including inside — Fallacy 4 (“the network is secure”) is the one that gets companies breached.

lessons.title: Zero Trust Architecture: Rejecting Perimeter Security Inside the Cluster
lessons.description: Why assuming internal cluster networks are safe leads to catastrophic lateral breaches. Authenticating and authorizing every internal hop.

lessons.title: Service Identity & Mutual TLS (mTLS): Cryptographic Machine-to-Machine Auth
lessons.description: Proving service identity via X.509 certificates and encrypting all cluster communication bidirectionally without code modifications.

lessons.title: Authentication vs Authorization: Edge Identity vs Service-Level Permissions
lessons.description: Who you are (Identity) vs what you are permitted to do (Permissions). Scoped RBAC/ABAC role enforcement across distributed endpoints.

lessons.title: Token Architecture: OAuth2, OpenID Connect & Stateless JWT Verification
lessons.description: Identity providers issuing signed JWT tokens. Asymmetric key verification (JWKS) allowing microservices to validate signatures without network lookups.

lessons.title: The Gateway Security Edge: Authenticate Once at Ingress, Propagate Claims Downstream
lessons.description: Gateway validates client credentials and injects sanitized internal tokens (UserContext headers) into downstream microservice requests.

lessons.title: Secrets Management & Rotation: HashiCorp Vault, Kubernetes Secrets & Dynamic Leases
lessons.description: Never baking passwords or API keys into source code or Docker images. Storing secrets in external vaults with short-lived leases and automatic rotation.

lessons.title: Least Privilege & Blast Radius Minimization: Restricting Service Permissions
lessons.description: The Enrolment service may call Payment, but must never call the billing database directly or read admin queues. Limiting breach blast radius.

lessons.title: Module 8 Exit Check & Mini-Build: Gateway JWT Authentication & Downstream Token Propagation Lab
lessons.description: Configure JWT validation on Spring Cloud Gateway, propagate user identity headers to services, and extract secret tokens to runtime environment variables.

modules.title: Testing and evolving the system
modules.description: Goal: change the system safely while it is running — because the system never stops for you to test it.

lessons.title: The Reshaped Testing Pyramid: Unit, Component, Contract & E2E Tests
lessons.description: Inverting the inverted pyramid: fast unit tests, component tests with Testcontainers, boundary contract tests, and a small suite of golden-path E2E tests.

lessons.title: Consumer-Driven Contract Testing with Pact: The Load-Bearing Test Layer
lessons.description: Consumers write tests declaring expected payloads; providers verify contracts in their CI pipelines. Catching breaking API changes before deployment.

lessons.title: Why End-to-End Tests Fail at Scale: Environmental Flakiness & Maintenance Nightmares
lessons.description: Why full-system E2E test suites with 50+ services become untrusted maintenance liabilities that train developers to ignore pipeline failures.

lessons.title: Testing in Production: Feature Flags, Canary Slicing & Shadow Traffic
lessons.description: The only tests that exercise real data and real user behavior. Feature flags as instant kill-switches and shadow traffic mirroring.

lessons.title: The Strangler Fig Migration Pattern: Incremental Monolith Decomposition
lessons.description: Never do a big-bang rewrite. Place a routing facade in front of the monolith, extract one service at a time, and shrink the monolith until zero legacy code remains.

lessons.title: Service Extraction Order: Least Coupled and Highest Learning Value First
lessons.description: Extracting the service that teaches the most about deployment infrastructure with the least coupling. Leaving complex relational tables for later phases.

lessons.title: The Reverse Gear: Merging Microservices Back When Boundaries Prove Wrong
lessons.description: Recognizing when service cuts create friction, chatty network hops, or coordination bottlenecks. Overcoming ego and merging services back together.

lessons.title: Module 9 Exit Check & Mini-Build: Pact Consumer-Driven Contract Testing Lab
lessons.description: Author a Pact contract for the catalogue-to-enrolment boundary. Break the provider contract intentionally to verify CI build failure before deployment.

modules.title: Capstone: split EduNest
modules.description: Goal: prove the whole course on a system you already know — a design document and a working skeleton, not a demo that only works on your laptop.

lessons.title: Capstone Deconstruction: Splitting EduNest into Four Microservices
lessons.description: Catalogue (courses, search), Enrolment (seats, enrolment flow), User (profiles, roles), and Payment stub (simulated transactions with controlled failure rates).

lessons.title: Data Architecture & Distributed Enrolment Saga Implementation
lessons.description: Database-per-service for all four domains, API composition for catalog views, and an enrolment -> payment -> seat reservation saga with compensating actions.

lessons.title: Gateway, Resilience & Distributed Observability Pipeline Wiring
lessons.description: Spring Cloud Gateway ingress with Eureka discovery, Resilience4j circuit breakers on payment calls, and OpenTelemetry end-to-end trace correlation in Jaeger.

lessons.title: Production Deliverables & The Failure Walkthrough Exit Defense
lessons.description: Authoring the Bounded Context Design Document, the 1-page Decision Log, and narrating the complete failure lifecycle when payment goes down during enrolment.

title: Java Core & Object-Oriented Deep Dives
description: From virtual method tables and JVM memory layouts to the Java Collections Framework, lambda functional mechanics, and clean code architecture.

modules.title: Object-Oriented Architecture & Runtime Execution
modules.description: Deep architectural analysis of OOP pillars, JVM method dispatch, and object identity contracts.

lessons.title: Encapsulation, Polymorphism & Abstraction Mechanics
lessons.description: Practical object-oriented principles tested against production engineering interview scenarios.

lessons.title: Inheritance, Virtual Method Tables & Method Dispatch
lessons.description: vtable lookup mechanics, invokevirtual vs invokeinterface bytecode, and composition tradeoffs.

lessons.title: Object Class Internals, HashCode & Equals Contracts
lessons.description: HashMap bucket collision behavior, identity vs semantic equality, and immutable domain types.

lessons.title: SOLID Principles & Architectural Clean Code
lessons.description: Single responsibility, open-closed, and dependency inversion verified through real-world refactorings.

modules.title: Core Java (Java 17+ or 21 LTS)
modules.description: The foundational engine: Java Collections Framework internals, lambda functional mechanics, modern LTS language features, and multithreading foundations.

lessons.title: Collections Framework (List, Set, Map, Queue, equals/hashCode contracts)
lessons.description: In-depth architectural analysis of ArrayList, LinkedList, HashSet, HashMap, ConcurrentHashMap, PriorityQueue, ArrayDeque, and equals/hashCode contracts.

lessons.title: Java 8+ Features: Lambdas, Stream API, Optional & Functional Interfaces
lessons.description: invokedynamic translation of lambdas, stream pipeline fusion, short-circuiting operations, Spliterator mechanics, and idiomatic Optional usage.

lessons.title: Modern Java Features: Records, Sealed Classes, Pattern Matching & Text Blocks
lessons.description: Data-oriented programming in Java 17 and 21: canonical record constructors, exhaustive switch pattern matching, algebraic data types with sealed hierarchies, and text block formatting.

lessons.title: Multithreading & Concurrency Basics: CompletableFuture & Thread Pools
lessons.description: Java Memory Model (JMM), happens-before guarantees, ThreadPoolExecutor tuning, ForkJoinPool, and asynchronous pipeline composition with CompletableFuture.

title: Docker & Container Runtime Mastery
description: Linux namespaces, cgroups, BuildKit caching layers, rootless daemon security, and production multi-stage image optimization.

modules.title: Container Foundations & Engine Mechanics
modules.description: Container engine architecture, Dockerfile layer cache optimization, and multi-stage builds.

lessons.title: Container Architecture & CLI Foundations
lessons.description: Container runtime vs virtual machine hypervisors, process isolation, and CLI lifecycle commands.

lessons.title: Dockerfile Internals & Production Architecture Guide
lessons.description: OverlayFS union mounts, layer immutability, build cache optimization, and signal propagation.

lessons.title: Optimizing Images: From Naive to Production
lessons.description: Multi-stage builds, distroless runtimes, non-root user execution, and trimming image sizes by 90%.

title: TypeScript Syllabus for React
description: The TypeScript you need to read and write real React code — in the right order, with the right articles, and nothing extra on the first pass. Designed for Java developers transitioning to modern typed frontend engineering.

modules.title: Orientation: From Java to TypeScript
modules.description: Goal: understand what TypeScript is and how its type system differs from Java's, before writing a line of it (Weight 5% · ~2 hrs).

lessons.title: How to Learn TypeScript for React: Mental Model, Study Guide & Roadmap
lessons.description: Why Java developers learn TypeScript faster, how to use the read-type-break-build loop, and what advanced type gymnastics to deliberately skip on the first pass.

lessons.title: TypeScript as a Static Type Checker & Erasure Runtime
lessons.description: Types exist solely at compile time and are completely erased during emit. Why nothing about TypeScript types exists in the JavaScript runtime.

lessons.title: Structural Typing vs Java’s Nominal Typing: Shape-Based Compatibility
lessons.description: Why two types with the exact same shape are interchangeable without inheritance or shared interfaces: the Car vs Golfer problem demystified.

lessons.title: Types as Sets of Values: Set Theory & Union Semantics
lessons.description: Thinking about types as sets of allowable values. Why unions (string | number) represent the mathematical union of two value domains.

lessons.title: TypeScript in 5 Minutes: Rapid Tour of Inference, Interfaces & Generics
lessons.description: A high-speed walkthrough connecting inference, interfaces, unions, and generics with runnable code snippets.

lessons.title: Free Functions and Data: Why Code Does Not Have to Live Inside a Class
lessons.description: Moving away from Java’s "everything must be inside a class" constraint: module-level functions, closures, and plain data structures.

lessons.title: Module 0 Mini-Build: Installing TSC & Observing Type Erasure
lessons.description: Set up a TypeScript development sandbox with npm, write a typed greeting script, compile with tsc, and inspect the emitted clean JavaScript.

modules.title: Core Types and Everyday Types
modules.description: Goal: learn the vocabulary every React file uses — primitives, unions, interfaces, aliases, inference, and null handling (Weight 20% · ~8 hrs).

lessons.title: The Basics: Static vs Dynamic Typing & Non-Exception Failures
lessons.description: What the TypeScript compiler catches before runtime, why tsc emits JavaScript even when errors occur, and how to configure strict compilation.

lessons.title: TypeScript Primitives: string, number, and boolean
lessons.description: Working with lowercase primitives versus JavaScript wrapper objects (String, Number, Boolean), and template string literals.

lessons.title: Arrays and Fixed Tuples in TypeScript
lessons.description: Declaring T[] vs Array<T>, readonly arrays, and fixed-length tuples like the pair returned by React useState.

lessons.title: Special Types: any vs unknown vs never vs void
lessons.description: Understanding top types (any, unknown), the bottom type (never), and void return semantics: when to use unknown instead of any.

lessons.title: Type Annotations vs Type Inference: The Java Habit to Unlearn
lessons.description: Why over-annotating harms readability: letting the compiler infer variable, return, and expression types naturally.

lessons.title: Typing Functions: Parameter & Return Annotations and Promise<T>
lessons.description: Annotating parameters, optional arguments, inferred return types, and typing asynchronous operations returning Promise<T>.

lessons.title: Contextual Typing of Callbacks and Event Handlers
lessons.description: How the compiler automatically infers parameter types of anonymous functions and callbacks based on their call location.

lessons.title: Object Types, Optional Properties (?), and the Optional Chaining Operator (?.)
lessons.description: Defining anonymous object types, marking optional properties with ?, and combining with runtime optional chaining (?.) and nullish coalescing (??).

lessons.title: Union and Intersection Types: Composing Shapes with | and &
lessons.description: Expressing values that can be one of several types (|) versus combining multiple object specifications into a single combined contract (&).

lessons.title: Literal Types for UI Status and Component Variant Props
lessons.description: Using exact string literals ("primary" | "secondary" | "danger", "open" | "closed") to create strict, self-documenting component props.

lessons.title: Type Aliases vs Interfaces: When to Prefer Each
lessons.description: Evaluating type vs interface: declaration merging, extension ergonomics, compiler error caching, and the standard convention for React props.

lessons.title: Strict Null Checks: Handling null and undefined Under strictNullChecks
lessons.description: Why strictNullChecks prevents the "billion-dollar mistake", and how to safely narrow optional props before reading properties.

lessons.title: Module 1 Mini-Build: Typed Command-Line Student Records with Zero any
lessons.description: Build a strict command-line record system with interfaces, Promise returns, status literal unions, and zero occurrences of any.

modules.title: Narrowing and Control Flow
modules.description: Goal: understand how the compiler refines a type inside a branch — the mechanism behind most TypeScript error messages (Weight 12% · ~5 hrs).

lessons.title: typeof Type Guards and Truthiness Narrowing
lessons.description: Refining broad types using typeof (string, number, boolean) and truthiness checks, with caution around empty strings and 0.

lessons.title: The typeof null === "object" Trap and Safe Null Discrimination
lessons.description: JavaScript’s infamous historical quirk where typeof null returns "object", and how to write rock-solid defensive guards.

lessons.title: Equality Narrowing with === and != null
lessons.description: Using strict equality (===, !==) and loose equality (!= null) to eliminate null and undefined in a single check.

lessons.title: The "in" Operator for Property Existence Narrowing
lessons.description: Narrowing unshared properties between candidate object shapes using the "in" operator (e.g., "fly" in animal).

lessons.title: instanceof Narrowing for Error Classes and DOM Nodes
lessons.description: Branching based on prototype chain verification for custom error classes and DOM element hierarchies (HTMLElement, HTMLInputElement).

lessons.title: Discriminated Unions: Modeling State & API Responses in React
lessons.description: The single most important modeling pattern in React: using a shared literal discriminant field (status: "loading" | "ok" | "error").

lessons.title: Exhaustiveness Checking with the never Type
lessons.description: Making the compiler mathematically prove you have handled every possible union branch using the assertNever helper.

lessons.title: Custom Type Predicates: The "x is T" Return Signature
lessons.description: Authoring user-defined type guard functions with custom return predicates, and using them to filter typed arrays safely.

lessons.title: Assertion Functions and Invariant Checks
